company.name: ZOKO
company.shortDescription: ZOKO connects businesses to Whatsapp and Facebook Messenger for sending notifications, marketing, and conversational commerce.
company.description: ZOKO connects businesses to Whatsapp and Facebook Messenger for sending notifications, marketing, and conversational commerce. The company's dashboard enables them to provide the best possible experience for customers and prospects on WhatsApp, while also qualifying and guiding them to a sale. It allows businesses to use WhatsApp effectively as a channel to sell online. Users can personalize conversations with them at scale – so they can engage, qualify, and convert them in real-time, day or night.
